Welcome

So glad you're here

Welcome to our home. We are so excited you chose to stay with us at Beach City Apartment and we hope you love your stay and Newcastle as much as we do.

Beach City is a beautifully styled two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment on the first floor of 23 Scott Street, Newcastle East. Sitting perfectly between Newcastle Beach and Nobbys Beach, you are just moments from the sand, ocean baths, cafes, restaurants and the light rail.

We prefer to keep in touch via the booking platform you used, and we are quick to reply. Don't hesitate to reach out if you need anything at all.

🌑 Linen 📶 Free WiFi 🏖 Beach Nearby 🚗 Secure Garage 🧬 Laundry 📺 55" Smart TV 🌡 Air Conditioning 🌅 Ceiling Fans ☕ Nespresso 🍷 Wine on Arrival 🏄 Beach Towels 🤞 Games & Picnic Basket 🛁 Quality Bedding 💈 Hair Dryer

With love,

The Space

Good to Know

Everything you need

📶

WiFi

Network: Beachcity2
Password: Beachcity27!

🌡

Air Conditioning

Reverse cycle AC in the living room. Ceiling fans in all rooms. Controls on the unit itself. Please turn off when leaving.

📺

Television

55" Samsung Smart TV in the lounge. Streaming only. Log in with your own Netflix, Stan etc. Unlimited WiFi for streaming.

🧬

Laundry

Top-load washing machine and wall-mounted dryer in the laundry. Laundry detergent provided. Clothes airer available.

☕

Kitchen

Fully equipped with Nespresso machine, Asko dishwasher, full-size oven and 3-door fridge/freezer 668L. Oil, salt, pepper provided.

🌑

Bedrooms

Two queen bedrooms, each with their own ensuite. Bedroom 1 has a full bath, private balcony and blackout blinds. Bedroom 2 has double-glazed windows and blackout blinds.

🍻

Wine on Arrival

A complimentary bottle of wine is waiting for you on arrival. Our little welcome gift to you.

🏄

Beach Gear

Beach towels, umbrellas, a picnic basket, esky, beach games and board games are all provided for guests to enjoy.

🌍

Patios

Patio 1 off the lounge faces Zaara Street with outdoor seating and a small Weber BBQ. Patio 2 off Bedroom 1 faces Scott Street with a table and stools.

👁

Bins

Please sort rubbish into recycling and general waste. Take all rubbish to the outside bins in sealed bags before check-out.

🚲

Bike Storage

Secure push bike storage is available for two bikes. Bring your own lock.

👤

5th Guest

A single mattress is available for a 5th guest. This can be set up in a bedroom or the living area. Sheets provided on request.

Arriving

Check-in from 3:00 PM

⏰

Your Check-in Details

Everything you need to access the apartment, including lockbox location and code, will be sent to you 48 hours before your arrival via the platform you booked through. Please keep an eye out for that message.

🏠

Finding the Apartment

Unit 2, 23 Scott Street, Newcastle East. The apartment is on the first floor, accessible by one flight of stairs. An audio intercom from the living room to the front door means you won't need to use the stairs to let guests in.

Before You Leave

Check-out by 10:00 AM

You will receive a reminder message the evening before your check-out via the platform you booked through.

🧹

Tidy Up

Leave wet towels in the bathroom, stack and run the dishwasher, and take all rubbish to the outside bins in sealed bags.

💡

Turn Off

Turn off all lights, ceiling fans, appliances and air conditioning before you leave.

🔑

Return Keys

Lock all doors and windows, return your keys to the lockbox. Full details in your check-out reminder message.

Getting Around

Transport & Parking

🚗

Parking

1

Secure garage parking included - one space in the private garage. Access details are sent with your check-in message.

2

Street parking - free after 5pm weekdays, 1pm Saturdays, all day Sundays on Scott Street out front.

3

Bus stop - right on Scott Street, 50m from the apartment.

🚋

Light Rail

The Newcastle Beach light rail stop is just 160m away, a flat 2-minute walk. Services run every 7 minutes connecting to the Wickham Interchange and buses and trains throughout Newcastle.

🚅

Rideshare & Taxi

Uber, Ola and Shebah all operate in Newcastle. Easy pickup from Scott Street.

🚲

By Bike

The area has wide, well-maintained bike and walking paths. Bike storage available for 2 bikes. You really don't need a car to explore this neighbourhood.

Get Outside

Beaches, Baths & Walks

Beach · 1 min walk

Newcastle Beach

One of the best surf beaches in Australia. Lifeguards patrol daily. Surf club, change rooms and kiosk on site.

Ocean Pool · 4 min walk

Newcastle Ocean Baths

Iconic Art Deco ocean pool, recently revitalised with free entry, lifeguards and warm showers.

Beach · 10 min walk

Nobbys Beach

Newcastle's most famous beach. Great for families and watching dolphins from the shore.

Ocean Pool · 15 min walk

Bogey Hole

A must-see carved rock pool in King Edward Park. Spectacular at high tide.

Walk · At your door

ANZAC Memorial Walk

Stunning 450m tribute starting right at your doorstep. Links to the 6km Bathers Way coastal track.

Walk · 10 min walk

Newcastle Harbour Walk

From Nobbys along the foreshore through Queens Wharf to Honeysuckle. Wheelchair friendly.

Walk · 15 min walk

Nobbys Breakwall

Walk to the iconic Nobbys Lighthouse. Watch coal ships guided into the harbour.

Day Walk · 15 min drive

Yuelarbah Track

Great day walk in Glenrock with lookout, waterfalls and picnic spots.

Reserve · 20 min drive

Blackbutt Reserve

182 hectares of wildlife, playgrounds and nature trails. Koala feeding at 2pm daily. Free entry.

Heritage

Fort Scratchley

1882 coastal fort that fired in anger during the 1942 Japanese submarine shelling of Newcastle. Guided tunnel tours daily except Tuesdays. No booking needed for groups under 12.

fortscratchley.org.au →

Heritage

Christ Church Cathedral

Self-guided tours and a tower climb ($10 donation) for sweeping views from the Hunter River to the ocean.

newcastlecathedral.org.au →
🌞
Local Favourite

Pacific Park Friday Chill

Free live music in Pacific Park every Friday evening through summer. Local artists, food trucks and family-friendly vibes. Just a short stroll from the apartment.

⛵
Day Trip

Stockton Ferry & Sand Dunes

Catch the ferry from Queens Wharf across to Stockton. Walk the foreshore, see shipwreck remains and explore the sweeping Stockton sand dunes. A brilliant half-day out.

House Rules

A few things to keep in mind

🚫

No Smoking

Completely smoke-free inside and outside at all times, including vaping.

🔊

Noise & Neighbours

Please respect our permanent neighbours. Keep the volume low and no noise after 10pm.

🧊

No Parties

No parties, gatherings, schoolies, hens or bucks celebrations. A responsible adult must be present at all times.

🐶

No Pets

We are unable to accommodate pets of any kind at Beach City Apartment.

👥

Registered Guests Only

No additional visitors beyond those on the booking are permitted on the property at any time.

🚪

Front Door

Please do not prop the front glass entrance door open as this is a security breach. Use the door key or audio intercom to grant entry.

Breaking house rules will result in the booking being cancelled without refund. By staying at Beach City Apartment, guests agree to comply with the NSW STRA Code of Conduct. Registration: PID-STRA-31708.
